historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved a residential care facility for seven or more persons at the site.
A two-story, approximately 46,500-square-foot office building, the Hjul Building, stood at the property. The present building dates from 2016.
The Hjul Building was constructed in 1929 as an industrial building and subsequently converted to office use. The present building dates from 2016.
One existing two-story building stood at the property. The present building dates from 2016.
The 375 Fremont Street building was constructed in 1929. The present building dates from 2016.
The City Planning Commission certified the Final Environmental Impact Report for the 375 Fremont Street project.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for a 250-foot-tall, 28-story residential project with approximately 225 dwelling units at 375 Fremont Street, as modified. The present building dates from 2016.
